phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: The paper's two main routes from Wigner negativity to GME are an optimized 2D phase-space slice and the center-of-mass mode after smoothing.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Conceptual overview diagram of the two GME-certification mechanisms.

phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: For any slice defined by vectors y,z with y∘y*−z∘z*=1, if the 2D Wigner negativity volume N_2D(ρ) exceeds the threshold N_2D^GME(ρ), then the M-mode CV state ρ is genuinely multipartite entangled.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Theorem-1 inequality relating a 2D slice negativity volume to GME.

phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: The GME threshold of Theorem 1 is always finite and nonnegative, satisfying 0 ≤ N_2D^GME(ρ) ≤ (4√(M−1))^{-1} + (2M)^{-1}.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Uniform upper bound on the GME threshold appearing in Theorem 1.

phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: A negative smoothed center-of-mass Wigner function implies GME, and its negative part lower-bounds the trace distance from ρ to the set of non-GME states up to a factor 2/π.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Theorem-2 smoothing inequality for the center-of-mass mode.

phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: If the nonclassicality depth of the center-of-mass reduced state obeys τ_c(tr_-ρ) > 1 − M^{-1}, then ρ is GME.
If a state ρ_1 has τ_c(ρ_1) > 1−M^{-1}, then interfering it with vacuum on a maximally-mixing interferometer produces an M-mode GME output state.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Vacuum-interference sufficient condition for GME generation from input nonclassicality depth.

phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: A finite-region Wigner witness certifies GME whenever the absolute slice volume V_2D(ρ;ω) exceeds (2√(M−1))^{-1}.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main text, Fig. 2a and associated example paragraph
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: For the tripartite W state, integrating the Wigner function on the equal-mode slice over a disk of radius r ≳ 0.7 is sufficient to certify GME, with V_2D(|W_3⟩;ω_0.7) ≳ (2√2)^{-1}.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: W-state slice Wigner function and its finite-region volume witness.

phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: A characteristic-function witness based on the most negative eigenvalue of C(ρ;Ξ)∘K(ℛ;Ξ) lower-bounds the trace distance to non-GME states, so any negative eigenvalue certifies GME.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Finite-point characteristic-function matrix witness for GME.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main text, Fig. 2b and associated example paragraph
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: For the same tripartite W state, the characteristic-function witness can certify GME using 10 independent measurement points out of the 19 marked points on the equal-mode slice.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Discrete characteristic-function sampling pattern used for the W-state GME witness.
